name: Mirror App – Social Mix
author: mirrorapp

sections.description:
The Mirror App Social Mix plugin allows you to seamlessly display content from multiple social networks in a single, customizable feed.

Supported platforms:
* Instagram
* Facebook
* YouTube
* TikTok
* Pinterest
* LinkedIn
You control the design, layout, and content inside Mirror App — then simply paste the shortcode into any page, post, or widget area.

All you need is a shortcode generated in your [Mirror App dashboard] (https://mirror-app.com/socialmix-feed/wordpress).
Paste it anywhere, and your Social Mix Feed instantly appears on your site.

Unlike traditional feed plugins that require keys, tokens, or setup,
this plugin does not process data or perform authentication locally.
Everything — from account connection to feed design — is handled securely in Mirror App.
The plugin itself is a lightweight embed layer for displaying your ready-made widget.

Why Mirror App Social Mix?

  • Multi-network support – Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn.
  • Simple setup – Configure everything inside Mirror App. No API keys or coding.
  • Auto-refresh – Your feed updates automatically.
  • Show/Hide Moderation – Hide or show individual posts.
  • Mobile optimisation – Custom behaviour for phones and tablets.
  • Layouts & Templates – Grid, Masonry, Slider, Carousel, and more.
  • Fast performance – The script loads once per page, even with multiple feeds.
  • Secure & GDPR-friendly – No personal data stored in WordPress.
  • Free plan available – Premium features unlock analytics, custom layouts, and more.

Features

  • Shortcode: [mirror-app-social-mix uuid]
  • Optimized script (loads once per page)
  • Compatible with Gutenberg, Elementor, Divi, and Classic Editor
  • Supports multiple feeds on one or several pages

Service description

The plugin does not process data or perform authentication inside WordPress.
It only embeds the ready-made widget created in Mirror App.

All feed creation, account connection, moderation, and updates occur in Mirror App.
The WordPress plugin serves as a simple, secure embedding layer.

Service Links

  • Mirror App Social Mix Feed
  • Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy

Legal Note

The plugin requires an active Mirror App account to create and manage widgets.
This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta, TikTok, Google, Pinterest, or LinkedIn.
All trademarks are owned by their respective holders.

Support

Need help?
– [Help Center] (https://mirror-app.com/help-center)
– Post a topic in the [WordPress Support Forum] (https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/mirror-app-social-mix)
– Email: support@mirror-app.com

Development

For developers: integration with vendor/iframe-bridge

The plugin uses the @mirrorapp/iframe-bridge library to manage iframe resizing and secure message communication between WordPress and the embedded feed.

Key features:
– Auto resizing
– Viewport sync between parent and child frames
– Lightweight client-side library (ESM/CJS/UMD supported)
– TypeScript support

Documentation:
vendor/iframe-bridge/README.md
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/mirror-app-social-mix/, or install it directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to your [Mirror App dashboard] (https://mirror-app.com/socialmix-feed/wordpress) connect your social accounts, customize your feed, and copy the shortcode.
  4. Paste the shortcode into any post, page, or widget area.

⚠️Note: The plugin does not handle authentication or API requests inside WordPress — it only embeds the ready-made widget from Mirror App.

Example:
[mirror-app-social-mix 12345678-aaaa-bbbb-cccc-1234567890ab]
sections.faq:
Do I need coding skills?

No. Just copy and paste the shortcode from Mirror App.

Can I display multiple Social Mix feeds?

Yes. Each feed has its own shortcode, and you can use several on one or multiple pages.

Is the plugin free?

Yes. The plugin is free. Mirror App offers both free and paid plans with advanced layouts, analytics, and auto-refresh.
See: https://mirror-app.com/pricing

Is it responsive?

Yes. Your feed will adapt automatically to any screen size.

Where do I customize my feed?

All customization — layout, colors, connected sources — is done in your [Mirror App dashboard] (https://mirror-app.com/socialmix-feed/wordpress).

Can I hide individual posts?

Yes. You can hide or show posts directly in Mirror App using Show/Hide Moderation.

Does it support popups?

Yes. Popup view supports author, date, text, likes, share, and source icon.

Does the plugin connect directly to social networks?

No. All authentication and API requests happen securely in Mirror App.

Will it slow down my site?

No. The plugin is lightweight and optimized to load asynchronously.

Is my data safe?

Yes. Mirror App handles all data externally in compliance with GDPR.

What happens if I rename a social account?

Your feed will keep working. As long as the source remains connected in Mirror App, changes are handled automatically.

How do I get support?

  • Visit our Help Center [Help Center] (https://mirror-app.com/help-center)
  • Post a topic in the [WordPress Support Forum] (https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/mirror-app-social-mix)
  • Email: support@mirror-app.com
